content: उपोह् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (उप-ऊह्) .²1 To propel, push or impel towards; उपोह्य रुचिरां नावम् <ls>Rām.</ls>; so धनुः. .²2 To push under, insert; कूर्चावधस्तादुपोह्य <ls>Kāty.</ls> .²3 To bring near, produce; connected with उपवह् in this sense; <ab>q. v.</ab> .²4 To accumulate, collect. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be brought about. .²2 To advance, begin.
